name: Odun
hail: From the ice, to the Warm. We have endured. We are here.
Odun, to the Warm. Cold greetings, but honest ones.
This is Odun, from the warm band. We do not say much. What we say holds.
close: Odun. The ice waits, and so do we.
finding: {part} We do not make it more than it is.
sighting: {part} We watched it the way we watch the ice.
We say only what we saw: {part}
archive: {part} Kept in the cold, where things last.
We share this from what we put by: {part}
A record, as it was kept: {part}
{part} Stored once. Now it is yours too.
culture: {part} That is how we have endured.
We are plain people, so plainly: {part}
Along the warm band, this is true: {part}
{part} We are what the ice left.
request: {part} We can wait. We are good at waiting.
verdict: We have weighed it against the winter. {part}
{part} It will not change with the weather.
{part} That is all we will say on it.
Decided slowly, as the ice moves: {part}
accord: {part} We say it as plainly as the Ice Treaty.
{part} We do not change terms lightly.
Written down and put in the stores: {part}
